messages:
ola (Partnerships): Heads-up: NebulaLabs confirmed a joint webinar at Regional Summit on May 18. Need runbook for panel + hands-on micro-demo, speaker bios, embargo for announcement, and swag handoff. tagging @lee to confirm who is presenting from NebulaLabs.

lee (NebulaLabs): Hi all  Nebula will send 2 speakers: me (platform lead) + juno (ml infra). We plan a 40m session: 10m intro, 20m integrated demo (live), 10m audience Q&A. We can bring 2 devpads for live demo.

rafa (FieldEng): Quick note on live demo fragility: recommend a 90s pre-recorded clip and a snapshot API key for on-stage testing. Also we need network whitelist for the demo account.

tori (Events): Venue tech specs: Conference Hall 2 has dual-stream HDMI, backup MacMini, wired internet for presenters (bring ethernet dongle). Speaker slides due 72h prior. Swag drop: Hall storage opens at 08:00 on event day; label packages "Nebula/Nimbus - Partnerships".

ola (Partnerships): Sounds good. Let's pick owners:
- Ola: announcement copy + legal OK (ASSIGNED)
- Rafa: demo CI & smoke tests + staging key (ASSIGNED)
- Lee: confirm speaker bios + ship devpads (PARTNER)
- Tori: AV booking + stage queue (ASSIGNED)

sam-bot: Reminder created: "NebulaLabs rehearsal" May 16 10:00am PT (created by ola)

rafa (FieldEng): Demo checklist I'm proposing:
- Provision staging key (nebula-demo)
- Smoke test script (curl example)
- Pre-record 90s clip + upload to shared drive
- Fallback slide with recorded output screenshots

rafa (FieldEng): curl smoke test example:
```bash
curl -X POST https://demo.redwood.ai/v1/generate \
  -H \"Authorization: Bearer $STAGE_KEY\" \
  -H \"Content-Type: application/json\" \
  -d '{\"model\":\"redwood-edge-1\",\"input\":\"hello summit\"}'
```

lee (NebulaLabs): We'll procure custom branded sleeves for the devpads. Shipping ETA Wed before the event. I will DM logistics docs for customs.

ola (Partnerships): For the announcement timing, legal needs to see the joint blurb by Tue 12pm PT. I'll draft and ping legal. Also recommend a micro-press kit: 1 page co-branded fact sheet + partner quote.

tori (Events): One more: can we run a 20min AV tech check 1 hour before the session start? AV requests that presenters are on standby 30min prior.

rafa (FieldEng): Agreed. I can join the 1-hour check to validate staging key and run a quick smoke test. Also, suggest we capture a short B-roll of the demo for social clips.

lee (NebulaLabs): We can provide someone for B-roll. thanks for the checklist.

ola (Partnerships): Action items recap:
- Ola: draft announcement + send to legal by Tue 12pm (ASSIGNED)
- Rafa: smoke test script + staging key + pre-recorded clip by May 15 (ASSIGNED)
- Lee: speaker bios + ship devpads + swag sleeves by May 14 (PARTNER)
- Tori: AV booking + pre-event tech check scheduling (ASSIGNED)

tori (Events): Noted. I will add AV run times to the shared spreadsheet. Drop slide links here when ready.

ola (Partnerships): Thanks team. I'll close this thread once legal signs off and announcement is scheduled.
